notes.title: Robo50 Joins Steam's Dinos vs. Robots Fest!
notes.content:
Exciting news both for humans and robots! [b]Robo50[/b] is taking part in Steam's [b]Dinos vs. Robots Fest[/b] from [b]February 26th to March 4th[/b]. Dive into the futuristic world of Robo50 by playing the demo and adding it to your wishlist during the event. Don't miss out on this thrilling opportunity to experience the action-packed adventure of Robo50!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089780/Robo50/
